scope: Public ReversibleCPMLSimulation, real FP32 scalar periodic x/y and z CPML, explicit fixed exterior material, point observations and fixed soft electric point sources.
physical_scope: Discrete implementation and memory admission checks, not a general absorption/mesh-convergence or throughput result.
gradient_scope: Only epsilon inside the descriptor-derived reconstruction interval affects the forward. All exterior material comes from a non-gradient fixed_epsilon input.
source_material_gradient: Interior source-cell epsilon is not frozen; source-cell finite differences passed.
history_storage: Four real FP32 transverse planes per step. Device or synchronous CPU archive, no asynchronous trace or disk claim.

checks: complete admitted material gradient relative L2 < 1e-4

cuda.memory_scope: Torch allocated increment for this tiny fixture only, excluding caller inputs, CUDA context and external allocations. Not a large-capacity measurement.

metadata_admission.checks: CPU/CUDA x trace placement, complete explicit budgets, current host capacity, diagnostic/material/transfer allowances and asymmetric CPML budgeted Project.

corrections: Initial public CPU test fixture omitted material_sampling=yee and was rejected before computation. The fixture was corrected without changing numerical criteria.
Interior CUDA address arithmetic uses 64-bit indices. Public CUDA checks ran after this change.
novelty: Boundary recording and reversible differentiation are established approaches. This integration does not establish a new algorithm or overall FDTDX parity.
